reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideCategories selection and parses the group note with the shared extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags instead of a hand-written regex.

duplication.why: The new exclusion is written once, inside the one selection function every month-wide action already uses.

placement.why: The rule sits in getMonthWideCategories in server/budget/actions.ts, the documented home of the month-wide exclusion rules, with its comment updated.

scope.why: Only the selection query/filter, its test and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; the exclusion rule is now split between SQL WHERE clauses and a JS post-filter, which is a small readability cost but justified by reusing the tag parser.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, ...) still obtain categories via getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; tag parsing is delegated to extractTagsFromText.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, consumed by every month-wide action.
